pages.text: King Nebuchadnezzar made a huge golden statue and ordered everyone to bow down to it. Three young men, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, would only bow to God.
The angry king said, "Bow down or be thrown into the fire!" The friends answered, "Our God can save us. But even if He does not, we will never worship your statue."
The king ordered the furnace made hotter. The friends were thrown in, but the king saw four men walking in the fire, and the fourth looked like an angel!
The three friends walked out without a burn or even the smell of smoke. The king said, "Praise their God, who sent His angel and saved them!"

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: The three friends were brave because they trusted God more than anything. God is with us when we do the right thing.

pages.text: Daniel was a wise man who prayed to God three times every day. The king loved Daniel and wanted to make him a leader.
Some men were jealous. They tricked the king into making a law: no one could pray to anyone but the king, or they would be thrown to the lions.
Daniel kept praying to God. So the king, who was very sad, had Daniel put into the lions' den. A stone was rolled over the opening.
In the morning, the king hurried to the den. "Daniel, did God save you?" Daniel answered, "God sent an angel to close the lions' mouths!"

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Daniel kept praying even when it was dangerous. Prayer is talking to God, and God always listens.
